channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marcus Thornton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marcus Thornton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Marcus Thornton
item.description:
WashingtonWizards President Ernie Grunfeld announced today that the team has signed guard Marcus Thornton and waived guard Gary Neal.

“Marcus brings experience and shooting to our backcourt and helps us fill a void caused by Gary’s injury with another veteran player,”

Ernie Grunfeld on Marcus Thornton, Mar 9, 2016. Source: Wizards Today.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Thornton
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy:

“Marcus Thornton can come off the bench and give you scoring and help fill the void we had when Jodie went down early in the year.”

Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Thornton, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Michael Malone on Marcus Thornton
item.description:
So if Fredette is going to play, he'll have to supplant Thornton.

“We're giving Marcus the opportunity (to start), but the reality is if we continue to struggle, we will not just stay with a lineup to say, 'These are our starters,'”

Michael Malone on Marcus Thornton, Nov 5, 2013. Source: Sacramento Bee.
